g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-404 Wrap labeler for round containers (built in house) · rev B
No product contact (container closed): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
TIP EDGE: R1 [.04], POLISHED, STRAIGHT 0.05; BEND DOWN 90° + 8° AT THE BEND LINE
WINDOW 16 x 25 UNDER THE WEB EDGE FOR THE GAP FORK
2 x M5 THRU (peel plate flange, H9)
3 fillet both sides, flat 0.1 after welding
2 x Ø5.5 THRU to 102 holes PS (S) or PJ (J), H9

svg.text: Arm is welded square to the foot; the peel tip then sits 15 behind container TDC, 1 above it.
One bracket serves both settings: move it between the PS and PJ hole pairs (Δz 24.9).
Ø16 f8; M8 x 12 both ends (tie between the plates); arms turn on it with nylon washers
Ø16.1 pivot, Ø12 H8 idler shaft + M5 set screw (H14); +x arm only: M8 x 15 at the end for the knob P1-458;
-x arm without the knob hole. Arm weight + idler presses the label at ≈ 15 N; lift stop at 40° on the sensor bracket.
Ø12 h6; 2 flats 0.5 for the arm set screws; DIN 471 each side of the idler P1-455
M12 x 1 sensor P1-457 in the 103 plate; bracket is the arm's down stop and lift stop (40°)
foot 65 x 24 + riser, arm 210 x 30; welded
